name: Digital twins of plants and assets
aliases: Digital twins of plants and assets
principle: A digital twin is a computational model that continuously uses real data from its physical counterpart to stay synchronised. Data flowing one way is a digital shadow; two-way flow including control commands is a twin.

process_steps.name: Connect it to live data via a digital thread

performance.basis: example quoted for smart energy systems, not oil and gas

source.note: Wikipedia, Digital twin, read 25 October 2026 (secondary source)

limitations: The Wikipedia page has no oil, gas or process-industry section
Disagreement exists over what counts as a twin
